description: This file defines the INoteRepository interface, which abstracts the storage and retrieval operations for notes in the backend. It declares asynchronous methods for listing, getting, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: INoteRepository
classes.description: An interface that provides asynchronous methods for managing notes, including listing all notes, retrieving a note by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: ListAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all notes as a read-only collection asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by its GUID identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new note with the specified title and content asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by GUID with new title and content asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a note by its GUID identifier asynchronously.
